newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 23.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 23.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average advanced to a new record high, rising 154.93 or 1.96 percent to 8061.65.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index lost 4.66 points to 1,018.01.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.6250/80 a dollar at around 0045 GMT, about even against 2.6230/50 at its Kuala Lumpur ending on Tuesday.
* Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad on Monday declined to comment on the speculation on the ringgit, saying he needed to study the situation first.
* Mahathir said there was no dispute on the Bakun hydroelectric dam project, only differing personal opinions.

* U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan will present the second leg of his semi-annual Congressional testimony on monetary conditions on Wednesday. On Tuesday, he cited a moderate trend of U.S. inflation, allaying investor fears about an early interest rate hike.
* Carmaker Proton said it has shortlisted three locations for a proposed car plant in India.
